name: Rockay Davis
quote: Ms. Paulette is a very impactful caretaker. She takes excellent care of our son, who is two years old. Our son has gained a wealth of knowledge while attending Uriahs Child Care. Additionally, she is a warm soul, and I do not know what we would do without her. Ms. Paulette assist us tremendously with our work schedules, and we are thankful for her. I would highly recommend Ms. Paulette to be your child's caretaker because they will be in great hands. You do not have to worry about their well-being while they are under her care. She is truly a blessing.
